No fields and no registry entry, yet it changes the outcome of the player's OWN checks: a critical failure to Recall Knowledge with any trained Lore becomes a failure. situationalBonuses already stores exactly this shape, including against a lore:* target (silvertongue-mutagen:1802 uses {kind:'skill', detail:'lore:*'}).

records.reason: Grants the armor specialization effect of light armor (and of medium/heavy if trained), plus an increase to those effects equal to your armour check penalty while in Tenacious Stance. Armour specialization is implemented nowhere in the app (grepped src/rules and src/sheet; only weapon critSpec exists), so a resistance the rules hand the player never appears.

fix.note: Needs an armour-specialization lane: the effect is keyed to the worn armour's group and mostly reduces critical-hit damage / grants resistance, which none of resistances, situational or modes can express faithfully. Once that lane exists, the Tenacious Stance increase is a stance-conditional bump on top.

records.reason: Reduces clumsy/enfeebled/stupefied (and drained at master) on the PATIENT you Treat Wounds. The app models only the player's own sheet.

situationalBonuses.ts:812 carries the +1 item bonus (+2 master, +3 legendary in Medicine) to Medicine for Administer First Aid, Treat Disease, Treat Poison and Treat Wounds performed with your blood. Adds 1d6 (2d6 at legendary Crafting) precision damage to damage snares you craft. Snare damage is dealt by a deployed hazard to whoever triggers it — not a Strike and not a statistic on your sheet.

innateSpells delivers the at-will Detect Magic, but the second half has no surface: your Perception proficiency counts as one step better when detecting magical traps. This heritage is in no registry, and situationalBonuses already stores rank-step effects in this exact form (memory-of-skill:2564 and pilferers-gloves:2583 both encode 'one proficiency rank higher').

situational.when: when attempting to detect a magical trap

records.reason: Not in FEAT_GRANTS (featGrantsAuto/Lane hold viking-dedication and viking-shieldbearer, not this feat), so neither half lands: the critical specialization effects of the battle axe, hatchet, longsword and shortsword, and the mirrored expert-or-better proficiency in those four weapons whenever a class feature raises your weapon proficiency. critSpecWeapons and weaponFamiliarity/mirrorBestCategory are the fields for exactly these.

The record carries a choice that RECORDS the pick, but none of the three benefits is applied: Heritage.choice is documented (types.ts:558-565) as a pick that is merely 'answered on the heritage step', and effectChoices/EffectGrant (types.ts:455-461) has no lane for max HP, for a saving-throw rank, or for armour proficiency — it covers only resistances/weaknesses/immunities/senses/speeds/skills/spells. So a Warden Human gets neither +4 HP, nor expert Fortitude, nor trained medium armour.

fix.note: EffectGrant needs hp / save-rank / armor-rank tracks (FeatGrant already has save and armor, so the cleanest route is to let a heritage choice resolve into a FeatGrant-shaped grant). No existing field can carry any of the three options.

Focus spells are auto-heightened by the heightening lane.

uses tracks the consumable, but the oil's actual effect has no lane: for an hour the coated weapon uses your proficiency rank in the OIL's keyed weapon group instead of its own group, and applies that group's critical specialization effect. The app tracks proficiency by category plus a fighter weapon-group table (build.ts proficiencies.weaponGroups) and reads crit spec from critSpec.ts by the weapon's own group, and nothing can rebind either per-item.

fix.note: Needs a per-inventory-item weapon-group override that both the group-proficiency lookup and critSpec.ts honour. Not expressible as a mode (ModeModifier is numeric only) or as critSpecWeapons (which grants crit spec, it does not re-key the group).
